response.overview: Super Bowl XII, played on January 15, 1978, at the Louisiana Superdome in New Orleans, marked a significant achievement for the Dallas Cowboys as they claimed their second championship title in franchise history, defeating the Denver Broncos 27-10. The game was notable for its historic defensive performance, as the Cowboys’ “Doomsday Defense” delivered a dominant performance, and two players, Harvey Martin and Randy White, were both named co-Super Bowl MVPs.
response.title: Super Bowl XII
